method.clock: pre-boot hook replaces requestAnimationFrame/performance.now/Date.now in the about:srcdoc game frame with a manual clock; one pump per step is an exact 1/60 s step (the game derives dt from the rAF timestamp)
method.randomness: Math.random replaced by a seeded generator before any game script runs
method.qa: the game's own window.silt.qa API, enabled by patching URLSearchParams in the frame (a srcdoc frame has an empty location.search)
method.input: keyboard KeyboardEvents (W/S/A/D/E/Q/B/Shift/F) from a closed-loop policy; the recorded run-length script is replayed
method.rendering: GL draw calls are skipped while stepping (the simulation reads no pixels)

tolerance.basis: 10x the largest observed session-to-session delta over 3 comparison(s), floored at 1e-6 m / 1e-6 rad and 1 step
10x the largest observed session-to-session delta over 3 comparison(s), floored at 1e-6 m / 1e-6 rad and 1 step
10x the largest observed session-to-session delta over 10 comparison(s), floored at 1e-6 m / 1e-6 rad and 1 step
10x the largest observed session-to-session delta over 11 comparison(s), floored at 1e-6 m / 1e-6 rad and 1 step

limitRides.reason: the ride collides with world colliders; the port has no colliders

limitations: The reference is a keyboard-only closed-loop controller; the original also accepts pointer/gamepad axes (continuous steer and lift) which the port does not need for parity.
The run flies at cruise altitude (>= 9 m) in the open so the terrain floor clamp (floor + 2.4) and colliders are not engaged; `impacts` in the trace must stay 0.
Chapter terrain, colliders and creature ticks are not part of the port's simulation (see examples/silt-and-signal-port/PORTING-NOTES.md).
